links.outcome: MLLM performance on egocentric clinical intent understanding benchmark incl. hallucination and sycophancy traps
links.effect: Current MLLMs struggle with egocentric intent due to over-reliance on global features, producing fabricated observations and uncritical acceptance of invalid instructions. No numeric results in the abstract.
links.quote: Experiments reveal current MLLMs struggle with egocentric intent due to over-reliance on global features, leading to fabricated observations and uncritical acceptance of invalid instructions.

unlisted_practices: Gaze-guided egocentric benchmark for clinical intent understanding (spatial, temporal, standard-protocol intent)
Trap QA testing for hallucination and cognitive sycophancy

screen.reason: The paper introduces a new benchmark (MedGaze-Bench) to evaluate clinical intent understanding, hallucinations, and sycophancy in medical multimodal large language models.
